name: A Bouquet of Magic
source:
You are a well-respected princess, and though you are not the heir to the throne, your family expects much from you. As such, your parents have appointed an instructor to help further your magical capabilities. How will you develop your relationship with him?

[from [url=https://himebee.itch.io/a-bouquet-of-magic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一位受人尊敬的公主，虽然你不是王位继承人，但你的家人对你期望很高。因此，你的父母指定了一位导师来帮助你进一步提高魔法能力。你将如何发展与他的关系？

[来自[url=https://himebee.itch.io/a-bouquet-of-magic]itch.io[/url]]
